records.name: ADNI
records.priority: High: principal training candidate after approved access
records.size: Dynamic longitudinal cohort. Obtain exact unique RID/PTID and QC-passed T1 counts from a dated IDA export; do not use ADNI4 remote enrollment targets as MRI counts.
records.raw_mri: 3D structural T1 throughout; ADNI1 includes 1.5T/3T, later protocols emphasize 3T. FLAIR, diffusion, ASL and resting-state availability varies by phase. DICOM plus MRI QC/acquisition CSVs and numerical derivatives.
records.clinical_metadata: Age/demographics, clinical assessments, CDR, MMSE, cognitive diagnosis, genetics and biomarkers. Diagnostic groups are CU/CN, MCI, and dementia/AD; early/late MCI distinctions vary by phase. Both MCI and dementia/AD can have CDR 0.5, so never map CDR 0.5 directly to a universal diagnosis.
records.access: LONI IDA application, institutional affiliation, proposed use, DUA and publication requirements. Official page says review generally within two weeks; annual account update required.
records.fit: Strong development cohort. Reserve a separate provider cohort for external evaluation; multicenter internal cross-validation alone is not external validation.
records.overlap: Participants roll between ADNI phases under the same RID/PTID. Group all visits, repeated sequences and derived slices by person. Phase alone cannot define an independent patient test set.

records.name: OASIS-1
records.priority: Lower: legacy benchmark or development alternative to OASIS-3
records.size: 416 subjects aged 18–96; 3–4 T1 acquisitions per session; 100 older participants described as very mild-to-moderate AD. Reliability repeat subset exists. Do not multiply acquisitions or slices into patient count.
records.raw_mri: Structural T1 MRI, with original and processed forms in the original release.
records.clinical_metadata: Age, sex, dementia status; use supplied clinical dictionary for CDR/MMSE fields and missingness. Young controls can confound disease classification through age.
records.access: Official access form labels OASIS-1/2 open datasets and routes requests through reviewed research statements and data-use terms. A NITRC account is explicitly required for OASIS-3/4; a corresponding requirement for OASIS-1/2 was not established. Follow the dataset-specific provider instructions; old mirrors do not establish project permission.
records.fit: Small legacy benchmark. Avoid if OASIS-3 is chosen for training or held-out evaluation; compare age-matched older groups rather than young-versus-demented shortcut learning.
records.overlap: OASIS explicitly advises against combining OASIS-1, -2 and -3: anonymized people may appear across them with different IDs.

records.name: OASIS-2
records.priority: Lower: longitudinal alternative, not an independent add-on to OASIS-1/3
records.size: 150 subjects aged 60–96, 373 MRI sessions, 3–4 T1 acquisitions per session. 72 remained nondemented; 64 were demented initially; 14 later converted.
records.raw_mri: T1-weighted MP-RAGE, repeated on the same scanner; raw and aligned/averaged, atlas-space, masked and segmented NIfTI forms described by release paper.
records.clinical_metadata: Age, sex, education, SES, MMSE, CDR, visit/timing, eTIV, normalized whole-brain volume and atlas scaling factor. The original paper describes 51 baseline CDR-0.5 cases as very mild AD, whereas ADNI MCI criteria also use CDR 0.5. Preserve source diagnosis.
records.access: Official access form labels OASIS-1/2 open datasets and routes requests through reviewed research statements and data-use terms. A NITRC account is explicitly required for OASIS-3/4; a corresponding requirement for OASIS-1/2 was not established. Follow the dataset-specific provider instructions; old mirrors do not establish project permission.
records.fit: Useful for within-person longitudinal robustness after grouping by subject; inadequate as an independent external cohort if other overlapping OASIS releases are used.
records.overlap: Original paper explicitly says many subjects also occur in OASIS-1 under new random IDs. Current OASIS FAQ extends no-combination advice to OASIS-1/2/3.

records.name: OASIS-3
records.priority: High: larger development candidate, or external cohort if not used in any model development
records.size: 2,842 MR sessions. Official page narrative reports 1,378 subjects, counter 1,379, and subgroup totals 755+622=1,377: internally inconsistent. Treat approximately 1.38k as discovery scale; exact downloadable eligible counts require manifest audit.
records.raw_mri: T1w, T2w, FLAIR, ASL, SWI, time-of-flight, resting-state BOLD and DTI; availability is session-dependent. FreeSurfer derivatives also available.
records.clinical_metadata: UDS clinical/cognitive assessments, demographics and imaging JSON/CSV. Clinical diagnosis is in OASIS3_data_files. Dates are normalized to days from study entry; predefine a clinical-to-MRI matching window.
records.access: Current provider uses NITRC-IR, reviewed application/DUA. Official scripts support selected session/type downloads. Old central.xnat.org instructions in older PDFs are not the current route.
records.fit: Strong rich-metadata candidate, but use person-grouped splits and preserve original diagnostic variables. A broad cognitive-decline category is not a single AD stage.
records.overlap: Do not pool OASIS-1/2/3; subjects can overlap under distinct IDs. OASIS is also a released subset of the broader Knight imaging resource, so KARI is not automatically independent.

records.name: OASIS-4
records.size: 663 subjects aged 21–94; 676 MRI sessions advertised. This is a clinical memory-disorder cohort, not 663 confirmed AD cases.
records.raw_mri: Volumetric structural T1; acquisition details and available sequences should be read from the release dictionary and JSON manifest.
records.clinical_metadata: Demographics, clinical diagnoses, psychometrics, CSF and FreeSurfer outputs. Contains patients evaluated for memory disorders and dementia of differing causes; preserve etiology separately from severity.
records.access: NITRC-IR account, reviewed OASIS request and DUA. Download nonimaging data from OASIS4_data_files, scans via UI or official scripts.
records.fit: Prefer reserving as a clinical cohort test rather than adding every source to training. May support AD-versus-other-dementia analysis if label/sample counts permit; do not recode all clinical referrals as AD. CSF assays have provider-specific compatibility warnings.
records.overlap: Provider states OASIS-4 is a unique cohort and can be combined with other OASIS datasets. This does not by itself verify independence from every other external repository.

records.name: AIBL
records.priority: High: geographically distinct external candidate after access
records.size: MRI/PET subset is smaller than whole AIBL cohort; provider states roughly 25% through 36 months and later enrichment. Exact eligible MRI participants/sessions require dated IDA/CSIRO manifest; no invented current total.
records.raw_mri: Raw DICOM; ADNI-compliant MPRAGE plus PD/T2, later 3D T2-FLAIR; both 1.5T and 3T. Some oldest noncompliant MRI acquisitions are excluded from shared subset.
records.clinical_metadata: Demographic, medical-history, CDR/MMSE/neuropsychology, APOE/lab, diagnosis and MRI-acquisition CSVs. Provider warns that DICOM age/sex/birthdate can be unreliable: use nonimaging tables.
records.access: AIBL subset via LONI IDA approval/terms and research/collaborator description. Broader access via AIBL expression of interest reviewed by management committee.
records.fit: Valuable held-out external geography; compare source clinical diagnoses rather than forcing four severity classes. Can join development only if a different untouched test cohort is reserved.
records.overlap: Australian AIBL is a distinct study hosted on ADNI-compatible infrastructure, not a new MRI modality or a guarantee of cross-source independence. Audit aliases and source provenance.

records.name: NACC MIXED PROTOCOL
records.priority: High but more curation: diverse multicenter clinical cohort
records.size: NACC advertises structural MRI for 12,000+ participants. This is not an assurance of 12,000 immediately downloadable QC-passed T1 volumes; freeze/date/sequence filtering and actual manifest are required. MRI preview estimates are explicitly unsuitable for publication.
records.raw_mri: Mixed-protocol packages can contain T1, FLAIR, DTI, T2 and other series; NACC cannot separate packages by sequence for delivery. DICOM/NIfTI availability; heterogeneous acquisition/QC.
records.clinical_metadata: Link by NACCID to longitudinal UDS demographics, CDR, neuropsychology, cognitive diagnosis and etiologic diagnosis. Match scan date with the relevant clinical visit, not the most recent arbitrary diagnosis.
records.access: Data Front Door Quick Access File request plus DUA; images delivered through controlled S3 download. Clinical summary data may arrive quickly, but don't promise image delivery timing.
records.fit: Potentially valuable clinical external evaluation or training expansion. Greater scanner variation and etiologic breadth demand source/age/site stratification and careful quality checks.
records.overlap: NACC explicitly says it lacks overlap lists for ADNI, DIAN and NIFD/FTLDNI. Therefore NACC is not proven independent merely because its repository name differs; document unresolved overlap and use available crosswalks/provider advice.

records.name: NACC SCAN
records.priority: High: standardized contemporary MRI within NACC
records.size: Dynamic dashboard of QC-passed exams/participants, not a fixed independent cohort total. Manifest count required; do not add SCAN and mixed-protocol totals without NACCID deduplication.
records.raw_mri: Required structural T1 and FLAIR; optional full protocol resembles ADNI. Defaced images and volumes/thickness/surface-area/QC summaries available for released scans.
records.clinical_metadata: NACCID-linked UDS clinical, cognitive and demographic data; diagnosis must be aligned to scan time.
records.access: Request through NACC Data Front Door/Quick Access File system under DUA. Provider notes not every submitted or QC-passed image has completed defacing/analysis for release.
records.fit: Good acquisition consistency for training or evaluation. Hold out entire participants and, where justified, institutions; inspect the actual release availability before planning sample sizes.
records.overlap: SCAN is NACC's standardized imaging stream across ADRCs, not independent of NACC. Cross-study overlap remains an audit issue.

records.name: MIRIAD
records.size: 69 participants: 46 mild–moderate AD and 23 controls; 708 serial MRI scans, not 708 patients.
records.raw_mri: Single-site 1.5T GE Signa, 3D T1 IR-FSPGR; repeated scans over two weeks to two years, including back-to-back acquisitions.
records.clinical_metadata: Age at scan, sex, AD/control group, visit MMSE; screening CDR/global and sum-of-boxes for AD participants. No MCI cohort and no validated four-class stage coverage.
records.access: UCL MIRIAD XNAT registration and data-use terms; project Download Images plus CSV exports from ClinicalAssessment and MR Sessions. Redistribution needs prior agreement; citation/acknowledgment and accepted-paper copy required.
records.fit: Prefer external AD-versus-control evaluation and short-interval consistency analysis; small person count yields wide confidence intervals. Augmented/slice counts cannot remedy that uncertainty.
records.overlap: All repeated acquisitions for each participant stay together. A single-scanner cohort is valuable for test–retest consistency but not evidence of multicenter generalization on its own.

records.name: BRAINLAT
records.priority: High scientific value; currently account-gated rather than immediate download
records.size: Primary descriptor reports 780 total participants: 278 AD, 163 bvFTD, 57 PD, 32 MS, 250 controls. This is a multimodal total; not every participant has MRI. Determine eligible AD/control T1 count from BrainLat_records_MRI.
records.raw_mri: 1.5T/3T T1-MPRAGE anatomical MRI plus available diffusion, T2/FLAIR and resting-state MRI in BIDS; five Latin American countries.
records.clinical_metadata: CSV demographics, cognitive/functional measures; CDR in AD, FTLD-CDR in bvFTD; MoCA and IFS. Do not include PD/MS as dementia cases or treat all 530 patients as AD.
records.access: Synapse project syn51549340, MRI folder syn53972968. On 2026-10-11 anonymous public API returns canView=true, canDownload=false, isCertificationRequired=true, isEntityOpenData=false for both. File content not downloaded; permission/registration is required.
records.fit: Strong potential geographic external evaluation after access, actual MRI availability and source labels are verified. No anonymous-download shortcut established.
records.overlap: Distinct regional dataset candidate; deduplicate against ReDLat/BrainLat-derived studies, which can reuse these same people.

records.name: UCB-J PET and T1W Images for Synapse Project Cohort
records.raw_mri: Raw native-space T1w, 1 mm isotropic MPnRAGE_VFA; PET also present
records.population: AD / MCI / normal cognition
records.size: 20 unique participants: 1 AD, 5 MCI, 14 controls; calculated directly from participants.tsv
records.clinical_metadata: Participant ID, age, gender, visit diagnosis, sessions
records.access: Acquired public release 1.0.0, CC0, no login/application. Pinned commit 4e23a0f47e955268df458729778f4d0ef1f2575a. All 20 T1w images verified against pinned SHA256 hashes and NIfTI integrity.
records.fit: Small external pilot or pipeline check; too few AD cases for reliable stand-alone performance estimates or training.
records.overlap: NIH-funded SYNAPSE, Wisconsin ADRC and WRAP; reconcile participant provenance before using alongside WRAP or NACC.

records.name: Alzheimer's Disease versus Bipolar Disorder versus Healthy Control MRI
records.raw_mri: Original NIfTI T1 volumes; source archive also contains processed derivatives, which are not additional subjects.
records.population: AD, late-onset bipolar disorder, healthy controls
records.size: 78 original T1 volumes and linked clinical rows: 35 AD, 19 controls, 24 bipolar disorder. Primary proposed AD/control subset: 54 people.
records.clinical_metadata: Acquired approved demographics: 78 rows with source diagnosis code, random study ID, age and source gender code, plus separate plasma biomarker CSVs. The paper describes broader neuropsychological measures, NPI and FAST, but provider-ignored clinical_data_corrected.csv was not extracted or used; those scales are not verified usable acquired fields. Biomarker patient linkage and interpretation remain unaudited.
records.access: CC BY 4.0; anonymous official Zenodo download. Original T1 members selectively acquired; full 5.28 GB archive checksum not verified.
records.fit: Exploratory AD versus control development pool; exclude bipolar from primary endpoint. No four-stage labels established.

records.name: DZNE Longitudinal Cognitive Impairment and Dementia Study
records.raw_mri: Cranial MRI; exact sequences and QA availability discoverable through DZNE clinical data search tool
records.population: Healthy controls, subjective/mild memory impairment, mild dementia, first-degree relatives of AD patients
records.size: 1,000 study participants; not a verified complete-MRI count
records.clinical_metadata: Annual clinical interview, detailed neuropsychology, blood; optional CSF
records.access: DZNE request form and use regulations; external requests reviewed by CAB/CEB. Raw data not an unrestricted download.
records.fit: Strong independent AD-spectrum candidate; verify diagnostic classes, MRI completeness and approval.

records.name: European Prevention of Alzheimer's Dementia LCS V.IMI
records.raw_mri: Raw/processed NIfTI T1w and FLAIR; ASL/diffusion/rs-fMRI in ~70% subset
records.population: At-risk adults without dementia at enrollment
records.size: >2,000 participants; MRI availability/QC per subject must be checked
records.clinical_metadata: Cognition, biomarkers, sociodemographics, vital signs, genomics
records.access: AD Workbench workspace and dataset application; imaging request specifies sequences/formats and includes clinical access
records.fit: Useful preclinical/biomarker or MCI research; not a source of baseline established dementia cases.
records.overlap: Recruited through existing cohorts including PREVENT; do not assume independent from parent cohorts.

records.name: ALLFTD including ARTFL and LEFFTDS
records.raw_mri: Refaced raw MR images downloadable via approved LONI FTLD project; volumetric data also available
records.population: Frontotemporal lobar degeneration spectrum / familial at-risk participants
records.size: >3,000 clinical participants across ALLFTD and predecessors; not MRI subject count
records.clinical_metadata: Demographics, neuropsychology, function, diagnosis, disease severity, CDR+NACC FTLD; NfL subset
records.access: Research goals, analysis plan, qualified investigator and DUA; review generally 4–6 weeks. Minimal or full clinical data can accompany MRI.
records.fit: Differential diagnosis / FTD auxiliary cohort, not AD severity labels.
records.overlap: ARTFL and LEFFTDS are predecessors, not separate additive independent datasets; NACC-associated overlap possible.

records.name: Genetic Frontotemporal Dementia Initiative
records.raw_mri: 3T T1/T2, resting fMRI, ASL, DTI, NODDI, QSM
records.population: Symptomatic and presymptomatic genetic FTD, relatives/noncarriers
records.size: Official study page: 1,900 participants; MRI subset/release count not established
records.clinical_metadata: Standardized clinical history/exam, CBI-R, FRS, CDR+NACC FTLD, neuropsychology, genetics, CSF/blood
records.access: Central data access committee; primary GENFI paper describes reasonable requests through study website/GENFI team
records.fit: Genetic FTD auxiliary cohort; not substitute AD or universal dementia-stage labels.

records.name: Frontotemporal Lobar Degeneration Neuroimaging Initiative (NIFD in LONI)
records.raw_mri: Longitudinal structural MRI; diffusion and PET in subsets
records.population: bvFTD, semantic/nonfluent PPA, cognitively normal controls
records.size: Current unique raw-MRI participant count not verified; do not use selected-paper sample sizes as total
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical/neuropsychological, caregiver, blood/CSF assessments
records.access: NIFD currently listed by LONI among studies one can apply to. Legacy cohort website inaccessible during lookup.
records.fit: FTD differential diagnosis only; reconcile overlap with UCSF/other FTD cohorts.

records.name: Four Repeat Tauopathy Neuroimaging Initiative / 4RTNI-2
records.raw_mri: MRI and tau-PET available by request for 4RTNI-2
records.population: PSP, corticobasal syndrome and variant tauopathy syndromes plus healthy controls
records.size: Current downloadable MRI counts not verified
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical, imaging, blood and CSF biomarkers through joint ALLFTD resource sharing
records.access: ALLFTD data request route; some imaging via LONI by request
records.fit: Related neurodegenerative differential diagnosis; not AD or automatic dementia labels.

records.name: Amsterdam Dementia Cohort
records.raw_mri: Clinical diagnostic MRI; sequence/scanner mix to establish
records.population: Clinical memory clinic cohort including SCD, MCI, AD, FTD, DLB
records.size: Official October 2025 institutional page: almost 7,000 clinical individuals, not verified MRI count
records.age: Mixed clinical referral ages; exact release range unverified
records.clinical_metadata: Extensive neuropsychology, clinical workup, EEG, CSF; many annual follow-ups
records.access: Institutional contact; cohort papers indicate reasonable-request sharing. No unrestricted raw MRI download verified.
records.fit: Strong real-world independent clinical test set if collaboration/access granted.

records.name: Alzheimer Biomarkers Consortium–Down Syndrome (including NiAD/ADDS predecessor components)
records.raw_mri: T1 structural, T2 FSE, FLAIR, T2*, ASL, DTI, resting fMRI; PET
records.population: Adults with Down syndrome, normal aging through MCI and dementia; sibling controls
records.size: 550 DS plus 50 sibling control recruitment target; not verified available MRI count; >50 sibling controls reported
records.clinical_metadata: Consensus diagnosis, demographics, medical/psychiatric history, neurological exam, caregiver tools, cognition, genetics
records.access: Qualified investigator request, NIH/study review, DUA, LONI after approval
records.fit: Separate Down-syndrome AD analysis; developmental/anatomical differences prevent naive pooling.
records.overlap: NiAD and ADDS were original ABC-DS teams; avoid treating as independent additive cohorts.

records.name: MEMENTO
records.raw_mri: T1/T2/FLAIR, diffusion, resting fMRI noted in DPUK matrix
records.population: Cognitive complaints or deficits without dementia at enrollment; longitudinal conversion
records.size: 2,323 participants enrolled; usable MRI count requires release inventory
records.age: DPUK imaging matrix lists 60+; confirm actual release criteria
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical, neuropsychological, psychiatric, lifestyle/family, imaging, biosamples
records.access: MEMENTO data access committee; application via DPUK; analysis remotely in secure environment, only approved aggregate results exported
records.fit: MCI/progression research and later dementia outcomes; baseline participants cannot be labeled dementia.

records.name: BioFIND dementia/MCI cohort
records.raw_mri: Structural T1 MRI with resting MEG
records.population: Approximately half MCI and half healthy controls
records.size: 324 participants reported; exact matched MRI/clinical availability to confirm
records.clinical_metadata: Cognitive group; clinical details/variables require dictionary
records.access: Exclusively DPUK according to cohort profile; approved research inside portal
records.fit: MCI vs control auxiliary/external cohort; not the Parkinson BIOFIND collection with same acronym.

records.name: Neuroimaging of Inflammation in Memory and Related Other Disorders
records.raw_mri: Structural and functional MRI plus PET
records.population: AD, DLB, FTD, PSP, late-onset depression, MCI and controls
records.size: 167 cohort participants in current DPUK imaging matrix; historical larger sample counts should not replace portal inventory
records.clinical_metadata: Neuropsychology, blood inflammation, diagnosis; longitudinal cognition in protocol
records.access: DPUK cohort approval and secure analysis
records.fit: Small diagnosis-specific subsets; primary protocol lacks longitudinal neuroimaging.

records.name: PREVENT Dementia (distinct from PREVENT-AD)
records.raw_mri: Multimodal MRI baseline and follow-up; raw images reviewed case by case
records.population: Midlife dementia-risk cohort, initially without dementia
records.size: 700 recruitment target; DPUK subset 210; neither is verified complete current raw MRI count
records.clinical_metadata: Neuropsychological, lifestyle, clinical, imaging, genetics
records.access: ADDI/AD Connect application approval; raw-image requests subject to imaging-team review
records.fit: Risk/preclinical work, not established AD training. Distinct study from Canadian PREVENT-AD.
records.overlap: Feeds EPAD and TriBEKA; participant overlap must be reconciled.

records.name: Amyloid imaging for phenotyping Lewy body dementia
records.raw_mri: T1, FLAIR, resting fMRI and diffusion indicated in DPUK matrix
records.population: Lewy body dementia, AD and controls
records.size: 80 cohort/planned participants; complete MRI count unverified
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical features and follow-up; exact fields need dictionary
records.access: DPUK cohort approval
records.fit: Small DLB/AD differential diagnosis cohort; not generic dementia-stage labels.

records.name: Quantitative MRI of Brain Structure and Function in NHS Memory Clinics
records.raw_mri: High-quality structural MRI with additional sequences; DPUK T1/T2/diffusion/resting fMRI
records.population: NHS memory clinic referrals undergoing structural imaging
records.size: 100 participants in DPUK matrix; a primary 2024 paper analyzes 272, so release scope must be confirmed
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical clinic dataset; age/sex/cognition/diagnosis details release dependent
records.access: DPUK cohort application; no unrestricted raw download verified
records.fit: Potential real-world clinical external validation; confirm MRI inventory and labels.

records.name: UK Biobank
records.raw_mri: Brain structural, functional, diffusion MRI; T1/FLAIR and other sequences
records.population: Population cohort, linked incident dementia outcomes; not dementia-enriched
records.size: >100,000 imaging attendees reported, not 100,000 dementia cases
records.clinical_metadata: Age, demographic/lifestyle, cognition, genetics, linked coded health records and algorithmic dementia outcomes
records.access: Official page says new applications paused; intends to reopen late 2026. Eligible institutional research plus legal agreement and UKB-RAP access.
records.fit: Conditional future risk/generalization dataset; health-record outcome timing must align with MRI.

records.name: AddNeuroMed and ANMerge
records.size: 1,702 clinical participants; MRI measures for 453 in the published release
records.raw_mri: Original T1 images plus FreeSurfer derivatives
records.population: AD / MCI / controls
records.clinical_metadata: Age, sex, diagnosis, cognition, medication, follow-up; incomplete modalities
records.access: Synapse account, collaborator data-use certificates and research proposal; ethical-review declaration required
records.fit: Strong additional structural MRI candidate; AddNeuroMed and ANMerge are the same source family

records.name: ARWiBo
records.size: Over 2,700 enrolled patients; usable MRI subset unverified
records.raw_mri: T1 and T2
records.population: Controls / MCI / AD
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical groups; inspect released demographics
records.access: NeuGRID2 form and dataset DUA
records.fit: Candidate; inspect release and overlap

records.name: European DTI Study on Dementia
records.size: 471 structural MRI scans plus 471 DTI scans; not 942 people
records.raw_mri: MPRAGE and DTI
records.population: AD / MCI / controls
records.clinical_metadata: Verify participant-level released fields
records.access: NeuGRID2 form and DUA
records.fit: Multicenter structural candidate

records.name: Italian ADNI
records.size: 262 participants across 7 centers; MRI eligibility unverified
records.raw_mri: Confirm downloadable structural MRI series
records.population: Subjective complaints / MCI / AD / FTD
records.clinical_metadata: Clinical groups; verify release dictionary
records.access: NeuGRID2 form and DUA
records.fit: Keep AD and FTD distinct

records.name: PharmaCog MCI cohort
records.size: 147 MCI participants followed at 7 timepoints
records.raw_mri: Confirm sequences in release
records.population: MCI
records.clinical_metadata: Longitudinal clinical assessments
records.access: NeuGRID2 form and applicable agreement
records.fit: MCI or progression study; not baseline AD dementia

records.name: Nigerian clinical MRI cohort
records.size: 88 participants; 761 anatomical sequences in 2025 paper; final eligible subset requires manifest
records.raw_mri: T1, T2 and FLAIR; clinical resolution varies
records.population: Age-related dementia / Parkinson disease / controls
records.clinical_metadata: Age and demographic/clinical descriptors
records.access: Brainlife identity verification and signed DUA

records.name: Fathi Alzheimer MRI Mendeley V2
records.size: 24 subject folders; 474 DICOM files; 10 AD / 10 MCI / 4 controls
records.raw_mri: T2 / FLAIR in local inspection
records.population: AD / MCI / controls

records.access: Already local; CC BY 4.0; DOI 10.17632/kcjt4v658x.2
records.fit: Separate sequence study; not compatible with current four-stage model without a new protocol
records.local_note: Page says 26 subjects, but listed class counts and local folders total 24. Do not inflate by counting DICOM slices as patients.

records.name: PREVENT AD open data
records.size: 308 subjects in CONP V2 listing; files are not independent subjects
records.raw_mri: Longitudinal structural and functional MRI
records.population: Cognitively healthy older adults with familial AD risk
records.clinical_metadata: Basic age and demographics in open tier; richer tiers differ
